Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Tourney Diplomacy Entry Tourney Diplomacy When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. The distant system is not empty talk only if it can be implemented in campfires, city gates and inns.

If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.

Entry Tourney Diplomacy Entry Tourney Diplomacy When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. They remember taxes, grain, labor, relief and who can speak for them; these grand names will eventually fall on the family's rice pot.
